title: Software Developer
description:
The Company:

Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Hexagon’s Mining division solves surface and underground mine challenges with proven technologies for planning, operations, and safety.

Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 24,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 5.5bn USD. Learn more at hexagon.com and follow us @HexagonAB.

Purpose of Position:

Hexagon Mining develops intelligent collision avoidance systems for large vehicles used mainly in open-pit mining. Its products integrate satellite navigation, digital radio, multiple sensors and actuation systems as well as sophisticated algorithms to reliably predict dangerous scenarios and prevent accidents. It employs approx. 100 R&D staff in several attractive international locations. The software developer will join the team to develop this solution.

Major Areas of Responsibility:

  • Design, develop and support our server backend services and client tools used for the current and next generation of our collision avoidance and safety system.
  • Collaborate closely with the hardware, firmware, and backend service development teams to realize new integrated solutions.
  • Assist the product-introduction team and gain first-hand experience with our products.
  • Bring in innovative ideas for further development.

Knowledge and Experience - Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent;
  • Experience in C and C++ on embedded or Linux systems;
  • MQTT and other IoT related protocols, networking technologies in general, and related network security aspects;
  • Full professional English proficiency;
  • Team oriented and able to work independently;
  • Positive working attitude and good common sense to understand business requirements;
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally;

Knowledge and Experience - Desired:

  • Web technologies, React.js.
  • Knowledge of OpenWRT and Yocto
  • Knowledge of additional high-level language, e.g., Python, C#.
  • Development and/or maintenance of software for safety-critical, automotive, real-time or control systems
  • Development of localization, navigation, or perception systems based on technologies such as GNSS, radio, UWB, automotive radars, and IMUs.
  • Implementation of CAN, Ethernet, I2C, RS-232 or SPI-based drivers.
  • Functional Safety.
  • Experience with Test-Driven Design, Continuous Integration, and agile development processes (e.g., Scrum).

Travel:

  • 5-10%

Benefits:

  • Health plan
  • Comprehensive health program (psychological, nutritional, legal, financial, and social assistance)
  • Wellhub (Gym)
  • Life insurance
  • Meal/food allowance
  • Dental plan
  • Private pension plan

You will work on products that could revolutionize the mining industry in the next 5 years. Your colleagues consist of highly qualified and open-minded engineers from all over the world. Beside the developer career you will have the opportunity to develop into multiple directions like project management, product management, customer support and sales.

Join our team as a software developer and make a significant impact on our clients' digital transformation initiatives. We offer a stimulating work environment, competitive compensation package, and opportunities for professional growth. Apply now and help shape the future of Hexagon’s technology solutions.

Hexagon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against any job applicant based on protected characteristics.

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.

Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.

Job Description

Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.

Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.

Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.

Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.

Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

Desta forma, as soluções customizadas de Autoprodução de energia Solar, Eficiência Energética, Subestações, HVAC, Geração de vapor, Consultoria e Gerenciamento de Energia atendem toda a cadeia otimizando a relação com a energia em diversos setores como Indústria, Shopping Centers, Varejo Multisites, Aeroportos, Hospitais, entre outros.

Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.

Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

Missão do Cargo

Garantir a integridade operacional e regulatória da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento, monitoramento e aprimoramento contínuo dos controles internos, promovendo a mitigação de riscos e a conformidade com normas internas e externas.

Principais Atividades

1. Identificar e avaliar riscos operacionais, financeiros e de conformidade associados às atividades da empresa de energia renovável.

2. Executar auditorias internas periódicas para avaliar a eficácia dos controles internos e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.

3. Manter-se atualizado sobre regulamentações do setor, garantindo aderência aos controles internos.

4. Fornecer treinamento e orientação aos colaboradores sobre práticas e controles internos, fomentando cultura de conformidade.

5. Desenvolver protocolos para tratamento de incidentes de não conformidade, investigando irregularidades e definindo medidas corretivas.

6. Preparar relatórios regulares sobre desempenho dos controles internos, com análises e recomendações à alta administração.

7. Colaborar com TI para integrar controles internos aos sistemas corporativos, promovendo abordagem sistêmica.

8. Avaliar eficiência e eficácia dos processos de negócio, propondo melhorias para otimização e redução de riscos.

9. Facilitar auditorias externas, garantindo fornecimento de documentação e informações necessárias.

10. Efetuar os testes e análises de acordo com as instruções do Grupo para o programa global de controles internos.

Requisitos

  • Superior completo: Administração, Economia, Contabilidade e áreas afins;
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado;
  • Pacote office Intermediário.

Desejável

  • Especialização (Pós-Graduação/MBA) Administração, Economia, Contabilidade e áreas afins;
  • Pacote Office – Avançado
  • Conhecimento em processos de controles internos
  • Experiência em Big 4

Local de Trabalho

Rio de Janeiro/RJ - Brasil

A ENGIE valoriza e estimula uma cultura de diversidade e inclusão, com orientação para igualdade entre as pessoas, respeito pela vida privada de todos e é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e assédio.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Mobile Sênior
description:
OBJETIVO DA POSIÇÃO:

Desenvolver e evoluir o aplicativo mobile, combinando experiência de uso premium com a robustez de um produto financeiro regulado. A posição tem foco central no Front-End mobile, responsável por dar vida a interfaces, fluxos de onboarding, jornadas financeiras e funcionalidades de conta digital — integrando APIs de Banking as a Service (BaaS) de forma segura, performática e escalável.

O profissional atuará como principal guardião da experiência do usuário médico, desde o design de componentes até a integração com parceiros financeiros, garantindo conformidade com boas práticas de segurança em aplicações financeiras e aderência às regulamentações do Banco Central (Pix, Open Finance, PCI-DSS).

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Desenvolver e manter o aplicativo mobile (iOS e Android) utilizando React Native ou Flutter, garantindo alta qualidade de código e performance.
  • Construir interfaces responsivas, acessíveis e com visual premium alinhadas ao design system do produto bancário.
  • Implementar e gerenciar o estado da aplicação com soluções como Redux, Zustand, MobX ou Provider/Riverpod.
  • Integrar e consumir APIs de provedores BaaS para funcionalidades de conta digital, cartão, Pix e transferências.
  • Implementar fluxos de autenticação e autorização seguros (OAuth 2.0, JWT, biometria, PIN).
  • Garantir o tratamento adequado de dados sensíveis, seguindo boas práticas de criptografia e armazenamento seguro em dispositivo.
  • Colaborar na definição de contratos de API junto ao time de Back-End e parceiros BaaS.
  • Atuar na definição e manutenção da arquitetura do front-end mobile (Clean Architecture, MVVM, BLoC).
  • Escrever testes unitários, de integração e E2E para garantir a confiabilidade das funcionalidades financeiras críticas.
  • Participar de code reviews, contribuindo com padrões de qualidade e segurança para o time.
  • Acompanhar e corrigir bugs em produção com agilidade, especialmente em fluxos críticos de pagamento e autenticação.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com UX/UI designers para garantir fidelidade e viabilidade técnica das interfaces.
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis (planning, refinamento, retrospectiva), contribuindo com estimativas e soluções técnicas.
  • Acompanhar e corrigir bugs reportados em produção com agilidade, especialmente em fluxos críticos de pagamento.

REQUISITOS DA POSIÇÃO:

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Superior completo em áreas relacionadas à Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • 3+ anos de experiência com desenvolvimento mobile (React Native ou Flutter).
  • Experiência com CI/CD (Fastlane), publicação na App Store e Google Play.
  • Experiência com consumo de APIs REST e/ou GraphQL em aplicações mobile.
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript, gerenciamento de estado e arquitetura de aplicações mobile (MVVM, Clean Architecture, BLoC).
  • Experiência com fluxos de autenticação segura (JWT, OAuth 2.0, biometria).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de BaaS e produtos financeiros digitais (conta digital, Pix, cartão).
  • Experiência com versionamento Git (GitFlow, PRs, code review).
  • Desejável: experiência prévia com apps de banking, fintechs ou carteiras digitais.
  • Desejável: conhecimento em regulamentações financeiras (Pix, Open Finance, PCI-DSS).
  • Desejável: familiaridade com provedores BaaS brasileiros.

Idiomas:

  • Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação de APIs e SDKs.

Soft Skills:

  • Senso de dono
  • Atenção aos detalhes
  • Comunicação escrita objetiva, concisa e consistente
  • Pensamento analítico — decompõe problemas complexos (fluxos de pagamento, edge cases) de forma estruturada
  • Mentalidade de segurança — pensa em privacidade e proteção de dados como princípio, não como checklist
  • Adaptabilidade — confortável com mudanças de requisitos típicas de startups em fase de crescimento
  • Proatividade e capacidade de trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar
  • Interesse genuíno em aprender novas tecnologias e regulamentações do setor financeiro
  • Hands-on

A empresa adota práticas de recrutamento e seleção baseadas na igualdade de oportunidades, sem qualquer tipo de discriminação. A avaliação dos candidatos é realizada exclusivamente com base em competências e qualificações para a posição.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.

Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.

TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.

This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:

"We can automate 80% of this."

And then actually build the automation.

What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.

Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.

Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.

Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.

Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.

What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.

Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

DevOps

  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Linux systems administration
  • Networking fundamentals

Automation

Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.

Languages

Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.

Why work with Quave

We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).

Pay and Benefits

This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

  • Fully remote work
  • Flexible hours
  • 22 days paid time off per year
  • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
  • AI allowance for productivity tools

We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.

Hiring Process

  1. Application review
  2. Technical conversation
  3. Architecture discussion
  4. Conversation(s) with one or more partners
  • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

description:

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Domain Architect Networking , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of Belo Horizonte - MG.

Job Description:

The Domain Architect – Networking will play an essential role in the design, governance and evolution of the network architectures that support the digital, industrial and corporate operations of Brasil and Canada. He will be responsible for the strategic planning, specification, integration and optimization of corporate communication platforms: SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, OT/IT industrial networks, Wi-Fi, underground networks, data centers, cloud integration, 5G, satellite and edge for mining.

Its mission is to ensure robustness, availability, performance, security, and scalability – enabling automation, digitalization, advanced analytics, industrial IoT, and support for key critical environments. He will work directly with global IT, Operations, Security, and Engineering teams, supporting multicultural and multifunctional environment

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, documentation and evolution of enterprise, industrial and mission-critical network architectures for global, underground, remote, mobile/IoT and cloud/hybrid operations.
  • Specify patterns, high and low complexity diagrams (logical view, physical, topology, VLAN, routing, SDN), considering redundancy, availability, performance, and resiliency.
  • Evaluate, select and supervise deployment of emerging technologies: SD-WAN, SDN, Zero Trust, private 5G, mesh networks, VPNs, segmentation of OT/IT networks in a mining environment.
  • Define and ensure compliance with global security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, PIPEDA), encryption policies, access control, vulnerability mitigation, and incident response.
  • Lead network integration projects between Brazil, Canada, industrial areas/mines, offices, plants and data centers, enabling high connectivity, performance and security.
  • Orchestrate processes of technological update, equipment replacement, configuration automation and network monitoring, including SRE, observability, Service Mesh.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation: diagrams, flows, contingency plans, playbooks, usage policies, governance, and technical templates.
  • Direct interface with Engineering, Operations, Security, DevOps, Industrial Automation teams, global architecture teams and strategic suppliers.
  • Monitor, optimize and evolve the communication infrastructure, aiming at maximum efficiency, IoT support, industrial analytics, autonomous mine operation and compliance.
  • Support the development of strategic projects (mining 4.0, edge computing, digital twins, cloud/industrial integration, ESG) and train internal teams.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or related.
  • Minimum of 8 years of solid experience as a network architect, working in critical industrial, enterprise/global, multinational and mining/resources environments.
  • Mastery of the main protocols, architectures and standards: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF/EIGRP, IPv6, DNS/DHCP, VLAN/VRF, MPLS, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, 5G/Edge, SASE, Zero Trust, OT/IT Convergence.
  • Real experience with Cisco (Switching, Routing, SD-WAN, SDA), Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Rockwell/Siemens industrial solutions, cloud networking platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Practical interface with complex environments: underground/mining, industrial networks, industrial environments 4.0, cloud integration, high availability, disaster recovery.
  • Experience in network automation (Ansible, Terraform, Python, scripts), advanced monitoring (SNMP, NetFlow, SRE Observability).
  • Excellence in documentation, technical design, governance support, multi-platform integration and international performance with remote teams.
  • Fluent English (essential), for Brazil-Canada integration.

Soft Skills

  • Technical leadership, positive influence, consultative action and consensus building between teams and global cultures.
  • Strategic and analytical ability to plan, execute, and evolve complex, highly available architectures.
  • Clear and assertive communication with stakeholders at all levels, internationally distributed teams.
  • Proactivity, resilience, focus on solutions, adaptability and collaborative posture.
  • Absolute focus on results – operational, safety, innovation and support of infrastructure.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certificações: CCNP/CCIE, AWS/Azure/GCP Advanced Networking, CISSP, VMware NSX, ITIL Expert, TOGAF.
  • Experience in greenfield/brownfield projects, integration of industrial networks/IoT, edge/mesh/satellite, mine digitalization.
  • Experience with underground networks, mining-specific wireless solutions, industrial OT/IT environments, SRE/observability on a global scale.
  • Participation in technical forums, publications, international events, benchmarks, leadership in strategic projects from large mining companies.
  • Ability to work in different time zones, multi-site environments and multicultural teams.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Robust and secure reference architecture for all Brazil and Canada network environments, including integration, automation, performance and high availability.
  • Execution of strategic projects for technological evolution, digitalization, automation, analytics and ESG, supporting business results.
  • Dissemination of best practices, technical painting of the teams involved, development of governance policies and global operation.
  • Active performance in innovation, benchmarking and implementation of new technologies that support the group's digital and operational transformation.
  • Ensuring compliance, operational resilience, risk mitigation and increasing efficiency for operations.

Additional Comments:

This professional will be a protagonist in the transformation and support of corporate, industrial and critical network architecture, enabling the global Brazil-Canada operation and the group's digital/ESG evolution.

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills

  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Application Engineer（Data Center）
description:
Role Overview

The Applications Engineer supports focuses on medium and large-scale data center cooling systems. This role plays a critical part in the pre-sales process, leading the configuration, design, and oversight of solutions including chillers, CDUs, Fan-Walls, CRAC and CRAH units, and advanced liquid cooling.

This position ensures technical solutions meet customer needs while aligning with company capabilities and sales strategy. The ideal candidate will have a strong engineering background, excellent communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and customers throughout the project lifecycle.

Main Responsibilities

  • Deliver engaging product presentations and lead insightful solution discovery conversations.
  • Configure and design data center cooling systems, including chillers, CDUs, Fan Walls, CRAC and CRAH units, and LiquidRack systems, based on customer requirements.
  • Oversee the pre-sales process, including site evaluations, customer presentations, technical walkthroughs, and proposal development.
  • Collaborate closely with sales teams to develop and deliver technical presentations that effectively communicate system capabilities and benefits to potential customers.
  • Provide technical support to sales representatives and customers during the pre-sales phase, ensuring optimal system configuration and design.
  • Conduct site assessments as needed to ensure proper system sizing and configuration for data center cooling needs.
  • Prepare and review technical documentation, including specifications, drawings, submittal and proposals.
  • Assist in the development of technical sales tools and resources, including case studies, white papers, and application notes.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive products
  • Participate in training sessions, industry conferences, and customer meetings as required.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Mechanical Engineering degree required, Master's degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 2 - 5 years of experience with a data center HVAC manufacturer.
  • Proven record of accomplishment of exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth in a competitive market environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of HVAC systems and data center cooling technologies, including liquid cooling and air handling units.
  • Proven experience conducting technical presentations and customer site walk-throughs.
  • Proficiency in CAD software and data center modeling tools.
  • Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Experience conducting technical presentations and customer site walk-throughs.
  • Ability to manage pre-sales system design, configuration, and documentation processes.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and credibility with C-level executives and technical stakeholders is preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, can articulate complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly.
  • Sound negotiation and consultative sales skills.
  • Strategic thinker with a customer-centric mindset and a passion for driving innovation and value for customers.
  • Highly motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with entrepreneurship spirit to promote products from the early stage.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders is preferred.

Work Environment & Travel

  • Travel/visit required to customer sites, data centers, or partner facilities—travel may include overnight or extended stays.
  • Local candidates are expected to work on-site at our São Paulo, Brazil office.
  • Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods, including during on-site facility tours.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package based on experience
  • Benefits package including Medical/Dental, Life Insurance, vacation, paid holidays, and sick days
  • Exciting career advancement
  • Global exposure and insights into the industry

About Airsys

At Airsys, we develop innovative and pioneering cooling technologies for not just the next generation, but the next century. We're reshaping the cooling industry so critical systems work uninterruptedly, with maximum capacity, and in an environmentally responsible manner. We provide a wide range of cooling solutions, including Medical, Data Center, Telecom, Semiconductor Manufacturing, and Energy Storage.

Our Mission is to sustain the critical infrastructure our modern society relies on by promoting efficient, reliable, and ecological cooling solutions.

EEO Disclaimer

Airsys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required for the position.

Background Check and Drug Screen may be required.

title: Coordenador Compras TI
description:
Criada em 2011, a Zurich Santander Insurance America é uma joint venture entre os grupos Zurich e o Banco Santander, dois dos maiores conglomerados mundiais nos setores de seguros e financeiro. Com uma das maiores carteiras de seguros do mercado, temos sede na Espanha e comercializamos nossos produtos por meio do canal de vendas do Banco Santander no Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai.

Na Zurich Santander, trabalhamos todos os dias para que você seja o protagonista de nossa história e tenha o espaço que merece dentro da nossa empresa. Se você é uma pessoa inovadora, dinâmica, proativa, gosta de desafios e trabalha bem em equipe, este é o seu lugar!

Nosso objetivo é oferecer a você as melhores experiências, queremos que se junte a nós para que juntos possamos construir o futuro da Zurich Santander!

Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades?

• Coordenar os processos de compras de Tecnologia da Informação, abrangendo software, hardware, serviços de TI, licenças, cloud, telecom e projetos tecnológicos.

• Atuar de forma estratégica junto às áreas demandantes (TI, Segurança da Informação, Jurídico, Financeiro e Negócios), entendendo necessidades técnicas e traduzindo-as em estratégias de contratação.

• Conduzir processos de RFP, RFQ e negociações complexas, garantindo competitividade, mitigação de riscos e geração de savings.

• Gerenciar o relacionamento com fornecedores estratégicos de TI, incluindo avaliação de performance (SLAs, KPIs) e desenvolvimento de parcerias.

• Fazer a gestão dos contratos, aditivos e distratos da categoria de TI.

• Assegurar conformidade com políticas internas, controles, governança, riscos, compliance, LGPD e normas regulatórias aplicáveis ao setor financeiro/segurador.

• Apoiar a liderança na definição de estratégias de sourcing, contratos de médio e longo prazo e iniciativas de inovação em compras.

• Coordenar e orientar analistas de compras, promovendo desenvolvimento técnico e alinhamento aos objetivos da área.

• Elaborar análises de mercado, indicadores, relatórios gerenciais e apresentações executivas.

Quais são os requisitos que procuramos?

• Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência sólida em Compras de TI, preferencialmente em empresas de grande porte ou ambientes regulados.

• Conhecimento comprovado em negociação de contratos de tecnologia (software, SaaS, cloud, outsourcing, licenciamento, manutenção e serviços/projetos), aplicando a metodologia de Strategic Sourcing;

• Vivência em negociações estratégicas e gestão de fornecedores críticos (gestão de riscos).

• Capacidade de atuação consultiva junto às áreas técnicas e de negócios (stakeholders).

• Conhecimento de processos de governança, compliance e controles internos.

• Inglês e Espanhol (avançado) para leitura e negociação serão considerados como diferencial.

• Domínio de ferramentas de compras, ERPs (Oracle) e Excel/Power BI para análises.

Para que possa fazer a diferença, é ideal que você tenha as seguintes softskills para esta função:

• Experiência prévia nos setores financeiro, segurador ou bancário.

• Conhecimento em metodologias de Strategic Sourcing e Category Management.

• Vivência com contratos globais ou fornecedores internacionais.

• Certificações relacionadas a Compras, Supply Chain ou TI.

• Perfil inovador, com visão de digitalização, automação e simplificação de processos de compras.

• Forte senso de dono e autonomia.

• Mindset estratégico e orientação para resultados.

• Habilidade de influenciar e construir relacionamentos sólidos.

• Capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

• Capacidade de adaptação a mudanças.

Qual é a nossa Proposta de Valor ?

Na Zurich Santander lhe propomos fazer parte de uma organização comprometida com o contexto atual, trabalhando profissionalmente na transformação da indústria bancária/seguradora, oferecendo-lhe crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.

Contamos com um excelente ambiente de trabalho, uma equipa de profissionais diversificada e internacional, incentivamos a mobilidade dentro dos países onde estamos presentes para que possa continuar a crescer como profissional. Além disso, dispomos de um pacote de remuneração e benefícios competitivo e atrativo para os nossos colaboradores.

Junte-se à nossa equipe!

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

description:

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Especialista Planejamento e Controle PL
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades da posição:

Consolidar o Fechamento financeiro mensal nas visões gerenciais da companhia;

Atualizar mensalmente os reportes gerenciais, comunicando de forma clara e concisa as análises financeiras e recomendações para diferentes níveis hierárquicos da organização;Apoiar na consolidação o Orçamento, em colaboração com as diversas áreas, atualizando premissas, metas e indicadores;

Atualizar e aprimorar o acompanhamento Real x Orçado, com análises qualitativas e quantitativas de indicadores de desempenho financeiro e operacional;

Criar e manter modelos financeiros e relatórios gerenciais para projeções, simulações de cenários e análises de sensibilidade;

Validar e acompanhar os dados em ERP (SAC Planning) apoiando na fase final de implantação do sistema;

Elaborar controles, processos e conciliações que visem constantemente a otimização dos processos de planejamento, orçamento e fechamento, utilizando ferramentas e metodologias adequadas.

Requisitos técnicos:

  • Formação em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Forte conhecimento em Finanças, Controladoria, DRE, Fluxo de Caixa e análise de Demonstrações Financeiras.
  • Experiência com processos de fechamento gerencial, orçamento (Budget) e forecast.
  • Excelente domínio de Excel (traquejo de planilhas), construção de relatórios e apresentações.
  • Conhecimento desejável em Power BI (não eliminatório).
  • Experiência com ERP (SAP/SAC/Oracle).
  • Vivência em setores como concessões, saneamento, construção ou energia será considerada diferencial.

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Wellhub
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos 507 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 31 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 19.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Analista de Planejamento e Análise Financeira | FP&A
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

  • Integração com áreas como Controladoria, Contabilidade e Negócios.

Requisitos:

Access Corp is a leading provider of secure information management solutions, helping organizations manage, protect, and unlock the value of their data. We are committed to innovation, integrity, and operational excellence.

· Help manage third-party risk assessments and vendor compliance reviews.

· Promote a culture of compliance and security awareness across the organization.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Security, or a related field.

· 3-5 years of experience in compliance, risk management, or audit roles.

· Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, HITRUST, LGPD).

· Strong organizational and communication skills.

· Experience with GRC tools and platforms is a plus.

· Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CRISC, CIPM, or similar) are a plus.

What We Offer

Liderança de Pessoas: Coordenação, desenvolvimento e mentoria do time técnico.

Conhecimento em Pacote Office e em ferramentas Google, incluindo GCP;

Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e ferramentas de BI (Tableau, Power BI ou SQL);

Conhecimento em conta digital PF e PJ;

Experiência com gestão de pessoas;

Inglês avançado e/ou Fluente.

Certificações em PLD/FT;

Pós-graduação ou MBA, em andamento ou concluído, com foco em Compliance, Gestão de Riscos, Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro, Auditoria e/ou Gestão de Pessoas.

title: Laboratorista de Controle de Processos III
description:
A Arauco é um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais e se compromete com a diversidade e inclusão em todas as suas práticas de contratação.

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Sobre a Função

Desafios:

Executar atividades laboratoriais voltadas para a qualidade, pesquisa, desenvolvimento, sustentabilidade e otimização dos processos industriais, garantindo que as atividades atendam aos padrões de qualidade e segurança e contribuindo para a competitividade da Arauco Celulose.

Com foco em atuação em Espectroscopia NIR (Near-Infrared Spectroscopy), quimiometria, manipulação de espectrômetros e interpretação de dados.

Principais Atividades:

  • Avaliar a qualidade de matérias-primas, intermediários e produtos acabados, assegurando conformidade com as especificações técnicas e apoiando a estabilidade do processo produtivo.
  • Realizar coletas e análises laboratoriais em diferentes etapas da produção (madeira, cozimento, branqueamento, secagem, recuperação química, águas e efluentes).
  • Registrar resultados, elaborar relatórios técnicos e recomendar ajustes para manutenção da qualidade e desempenho operacional.
  • Participar de iniciativas de pesquisa, desenvolvimento e melhoria contínua dos processos e do produto final.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas técnicas, ambientais e de segurança, seguindo boas práticas de laboratório.
  • Zelar pela organização, conservação e funcionamento dos equipamentos e insumos laboratoriais.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho do laboratório (prazo, precisão e custo), propondo melhorias para aumento de eficiência.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a operação e colaborar com projetos de otimização e inovação.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Curso técnico completo em Celulose e Papel, Química ou áreas correlatas;
  • Ensino superior em Química, Engenharias e/ou áreas afins;
  • Integração em Segurança;
  • Conhecimento em Ferramentas da Qualidade;
  • Excel intermediário;
  • Domínio de técnicas laboratoriais e operação de equipamentos (espectrofotômetro, viscosímetro, cromatografia);
  • Conhecimento em química aplicada à produção de celulose e processos industriais;
  • CNH categoria B.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Inocência/MS.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol;
  • SAP, Power BI e LIMS;
  • Vivência em comissionamento e startup de plantas de Celulose e/ou Papel;
  • Conhecimento das NRs 10, 12, 13, 33 e 35;
  • Conhecimento em análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Conhecimento em sustentabilidade e práticas ESG;
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes ou projetos.

title: Analista de CRM Sênior
description:

Mantemos um ambiente descontraído, onde cada ideia conta. Na base da colaboração e criatividade, a gente está sempre evoluindo e de olho nas tendências que movem o mundo fitness

Aqui é tudo sobre o "porquê" fazemos o que fazemos. Apesar de sermos o maior Grupo de academias da América Latina, sabemos que a saúde e o bem-estar devem ser integral.

title: Partner Development Representative - English Speaker (supporting the North American region)
description:
Partner Development Representative - English Speaker (supporting the North American region)

Department: Global Sales Development

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Languages: Fluent in English

Job Type: Hybrid

Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

As a Partner Development Representative (PDR I), you will identify and accelerate growth opportunities across a designated segment of our Docusign partner ecosystem. You’ll execute targeted outbound campaigns, qualify event- and marketing-generated leads, and surface high‑value accounts to foster new and expanded partnerships. Success in this role requires consistent, high‑quality activity, strong cross‑functional collaboration, and disciplined pipeline management.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, Partner Development and is designated Hybrid .

Responsibility

  • Partner with direct sales (AEs/AMs) to create and progress qualified pipeline from partner-sourced and partner-influenced leads
  • Develop and maintain strong, professional relationships with referral partners to drive consistent lead flow and co-selling motion
  • Engage referral partners’ customers to generate bottom‑up interest in Docusign, uncovering needs and setting qualified meetings
  • Analyze integration and web usage data to align customers to the right plans and identify expansion triggers
  • Maintain a book of referral partners; run regular pipeline reviews, align on targets, and ensure timely follow‑up and SLA adherence
  • Plan and execute quarterly account planning and enablement sessions with Business Development and key referral partners (in-person or virtual)
  • Use Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to research accounts, identify key contacts, sequence outreach, and track outcomes
  • Maintain daily call targets (plus emails/social touches) and achieve monthly and quarterly pipeline and meeting goals

Job Designation

Hybrid: Employees divide their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 3 days per week in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 1+ year of relevant experience in sales, business development, or partner development
  • Proficiency in English required (supporting the North American region)

Preferred

  • 1+ year in a quota-carrying inside sales or SDR/BDR role (SaaS preferred), including prospecting, forecasting, and closing or setting net‑new meetings
  • Experience selling with or through partners (e.g., referral, reseller, ISV, Hyperscalers)
  • Proficiency with Salesforce (CRM), Outreach (sequencing), and LinkedIn (research/prospecting)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
  • Strong problem‑solving, attention to detail, and demonstrated technical acumen
  • Ability to prioritize, manage a high‑volume pipeline, and collaborate across sales, marketing, and partner teams

Life at DocuSign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Accommodation

Docusign provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, including if you need accommodation to properly utilize our online system, you may contact us at .

If you experience any technical difficulties or issues during the application process, or with our interview tools, please reach out to us at for assistance.

title: Warranty Intern
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role

The Warranty Intern will play an important role in supporting Vammo’s Warranty and Quality operations, contributing directly to product reliability and continuous improvement. This position is responsible for assisting in the evaluation and analysis of warranty claims, ensuring accurate documentation, proper categorization of failure types, and structured tracking of quality-related data.

The intern will support the investigation of returned components, help organize evidence for root cause analysis, and ensure that warranty processes follow defined quality standards. You will work closely with the Manufacturing Quality and Aftersales team, gaining hands-on experience in warranty evaluation, defect tracking, and quality reporting.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who is highly organized, disciplined, and committed and wants to build a strong foundation in Supply Chain.

Hard Skills

• Logistics, Engineering, Administration, or related fields)

• Basic Excel skills (data entry, simple organization, filters)

• Strong organizational capability

• Ability to follow structured processes

• Basic understanding of operational routines (prior apprentice experience is a plus)

• Availability for hands-on operational activities

Soft Skills

• Highly organized and detail-oriented

• Responsible and committed

• Strong discipline and reliability

• Willingness to learn }

• Good communication skills

• Punctual and process-driven

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Descrição da Vaga

O Estagio de Garantia terá um papel importante no suporte às operações de Garantia e Qualidade da Vammo, contribuindo diretamente para a confiabilidade do produto e para a melhoria contínua.

Esta posição é responsável por auxiliar na avaliação e análise de chamados de garantia, garantindo documentação precisa, categorização adequada dos tipos de falha e acompanhamento estruturado dos dados relacionados à qualidade.

Também dará suporte à investigação de componentes retornados, ajudará a organizar evidências para análises de causa raiz e garantirá que os processos de garantia sigam os padrões de qualidade definidos.

Você trabalhará em conjunto com o time de Qualidade, Manufatura e Pós-Venda, adquirindo experiência prática em avaliação de garantia, rastreamento de defeitos e elaboração de relatórios de qualidade.

Esta oportunidade é ideal para alguém organizado, disciplinado e comprometido, que deseja construir uma base sólida nas áreas de Supply Chain.

Hard Skills

  • Cursando Logística, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Excel (entrada de dados, organização simples, uso de filtros).
  • Forte capacidade de organização.
  • Capacidade de seguir processos estruturados.
  • Entendimento básico de rotinas operacionais (experiência prévia como jovem aprendiz é um diferencial).
  • Disponibilidade para atividades operacionais práticas.

Soft Skills

  • Alto nível de organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Responsabilidade e comprometimento.
  • Forte disciplina e confiabilidade.
  • Vontade de aprender.
  • Boa comunicação.
  • Pontualidade e orientação a processos.

Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.

What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity

Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices

Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects

Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Regional Sales Executive[Portuguese]
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Job Description

We are seeking a driven and results-oriented Regional Sales Executive to drive the regional sales and affiliate partnership efforts in Brazil. Reporting to the Country Manager, you will be responsible for acquiring and managing new affiliate partners, driving the region's growth, and developing strategic relationships to elevate the company’s market position. This full-time role will provide an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in the company's expansion while focusing on affiliate partnerships to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Affiliate Partner Acquisition & Management: Identify, onboard, and manage new affiliate partners, merchants, and strategic partners to expand the company’s affiliate network and drive revenue growth in Brazil.
  • Partnership Development & Negotiation: Negotiate affiliate terms, contracts, and collaboration agreements to ensure mutually beneficial outcomes. Work closely with the marketing team to create tailored campaigns and offers that align with affiliate partners’ audiences and Bybit’s brand.
  • Relationship Management: Maintain regular communication with affiliates, monitoring the performance of partnerships, and providing ongoing support and resources to optimize results. Foster long-term relationships with affiliates, ensuring they have the tools, incentives, and resources to succeed. Act as the main point of contact for affiliates, addressing any issues or concerns in a timely and professional manner.
  • Affiliate Onboarding: Guide new affiliates through the onboarding process, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary tools, resources, and understanding of the company’s offerings to drive performance.
  • Market Insights & Strategy: Conduct in-depth market research to identify emerging trends, competitive strategies, and new affiliate opportunities. Use these insights to refine outreach and acquisition strategies.
  • Sales & Affiliate Reporting: Track and analyze key performance metrics related to affiliate performance, client acquisition, and outreach efforts. Report progress to the Country Manager and provide strategic feedback to improve future efforts.
  • Administrative & Organizational Support: Oversee administrative tasks related to affiliate management, including record-keeping, scheduling meetings, managing communication, and preparing performance reports.
  • Event Coordination: Assist in the planning and execution of events focused on building affiliate partnerships, such as affiliate conferences, merchant meetups, or industry workshops.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in sales, affiliate marketing, or business development with a focus on managing relationships and partnerships.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively pitch affiliate opportunities and build rapport with key stakeholders.
  • Strategic mindset with a keen understanding of affiliate marketing trends, market dynamics, and how to leverage them for business success.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of handling multiple projects, managing time effectively, and keeping affiliate partners engaged and satisfied.
  • Self-starter with a proactive attitude, attention to detail, and a passion for driving business results through affiliate partnerships.

Why Join Us

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

Our benefits include:

  • Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
  • Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
  • Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
  • Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
  • Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
